A.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Match denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fractional parts as equivalent fractions before subtracting when the denominators do not already match.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when a step converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with the same denominator.
Tag for mixed-number problems if only the fractional parts are rewritten to a common denominator.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag mere classification statements unless they are accompanied by actual denominator matching work.
Do not tag simplification of the final answer.

skills.name: Normalize mixed form
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or a mixed number into a subtraction-ready form, such as adding a zero fractional part or converting an improper fractional part to a standard mixed number.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus a zero fraction, such as 3 = 3 + 0/5.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized, such as 2 3/2 = 3 1/2.
Tag when this rewriting is done to align whole and fractional parts for later subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary combination of whole and fraction parts after subtraction.
Do not tag borrowing from the whole part; that is a separate regrouping action.
Do not tag common-denominator conversion unless the step also rewrites the overall number form.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator and/or subtract the whole-number parts once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole parts of mixed numbers are subtracted.
Tag when a step performs both whole-part and fraction-part subtraction in parallel.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is to create a common denominator.
Do not tag borrowing or regrouping steps that adjust the whole and fractional parts after a negative fractional result appears.
Do not tag final simplification or formatting only.

skills.name: Borrow in mixed subtraction
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as an equivalent fraction and adjust the whole part when the fractional part of the minuend is too small to subtract the fractional part of the subtrahend.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly borrows 1 from the whole part.
Tag when 1 whole is converted into denominator-over-denominator, such as 12/12 or 5/5, and added to the existing fractional part.
Tag when regrouping resolves a negative fractional difference in mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag simple subtraction when no regrouping is needed.
Do not tag normalization steps like rewriting a whole as 3 + 0/5 unless a later borrowing action is actually performed in that step.
Do not tag simplification of the resulting fraction.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce the subtraction result to lowest terms or to an integer when the fractional part simplifies to a whole-number value or zero.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced, such as 2/10 = 1/5 or 9/12 = 3/4.
Tag when 0 over a denominator is simplified to 0.
Tag when a mixed or combined result is simplified to an integer because the fractional part is zero.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag unsimplified subtraction results if no reduction is shown.
Do not tag merely writing the final answer in mixed-number form when no simplification occurs.
Do not tag common-denominator conversion.

skills.name: Compose final form
skills.definition: Combine the computed whole-number and fractional parts into the final mixed number, fraction, or integer representation.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole and fractional results are recombined into one answer.
Tag when a result with whole part 0 is expressed as a proper fraction.
Tag when a result with fractional part 0 is expressed as an integer.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the subtraction itself.
Do not tag simplification of a fraction unless the step also explicitly recombines parts into the final form.
Do not tag initial rewriting of numbers before subtraction.

B.domain: Subtraction of fractions and mixed numbers with simplification

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when denominators do not already match.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when fraction parts are converted to equivalent fractions to match denominators before subtracting.
Tag for both pure-fraction items and mixed-number items with unlike fractional denominators.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag steps that only subtract numerators after denominators already match.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number unless it also includes denominator matching.

skills.name: Normalize mixed form
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or a mixed number into a subtraction-ready form, such as converting an improper mixed number to a standard mixed number or expressing a whole number as a whole plus 0 over a denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized to a standard mixed number.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a denominator to align whole and fraction parts.
Tag when a mixed number is explicitly decomposed into whole and fractional parts for later subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction of already-ready mixed numbers.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping after subtraction has begun.
Do not tag common-denominator conversion unless the step also rewrites the number's form as described.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator and/or subtract the whole-number and fractional parts once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted for fractions that already share a denominator.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted directly.
Tag when the subtraction step may produce a zero or negative fractional part before any borrowing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is finding a common denominator.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps that adjust a negative fractional result.
Do not tag final simplification or recombination unless subtraction itself is performed in that step.

skills.name: Borrow across parts
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units to continue subtraction when the fractional part of the minuend is smaller than the fractional part of the subtrahend.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly borrows 1 from the whole-number part.
Tag when 1 whole is converted into denominator-over-denominator and added to the existing fractional part.
Tag when borrowing resolves a negative fractional difference in mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag direct subtraction when no regrouping is needed.
Do not tag normalization of improper mixed numbers before subtraction.
Do not tag simplification of the final fraction after subtraction.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce a fractional result to lowest terms or convert a zero-valued fraction to 0 after subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced by a common factor after subtraction.
Tag when a result like 0 over n is simplified to 0.
Tag when simplification is stated explicitly in its own step or combined with the final statement.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction steps that already happen to produce a lowest-terms answer without any simplification action stated.
Do not tag recombining whole and fraction parts unless reduction or zero simplification is also performed.
Do not tag finding equivalent fractions for a common denominator.

skills.name: Compose final answer
skills.definition: Combine the computed whole-number and fractional parts, or recognize that only a whole number or only a fraction remains, to state the final result.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole and fractional results are combined into a mixed number.
Tag when a zero whole part is omitted to present a proper fraction.
Tag when whole and fractional results are combined to state an integer or final mixed-number answer.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag intermediate subtraction of whole or fraction parts.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps.
Do not tag simplification alone unless the step also explicitly assembles the final form.

C.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Match denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fractional parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when the denominators are not already aligned.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator
Tag when a step converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with the same denominator
Tag for unlike-denominator fraction subtraction and mixed-number subtraction whose fractional parts must be aligned
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed
Do not tag mere classification steps that name a problem type without changing denominators
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number unless a common-denominator conversion is also performed

skills.name: Normalize whole/mixed form
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or a mixed number into a subtraction-ready form, such as converting an improper mixed number to a standard mixed number or expressing a whole number as a whole plus a zero fraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number with an improper fractional part is normalized to a standard mixed number
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a chosen denominator
Tag when a mixed number is explicitly decomposed into whole and fractional parts to set up subtraction
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction of already-ready whole and fractional parts
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps
Do not tag common-denominator conversion unless the step also rewrites a whole or improper mixed number

skills.name: Subtract aligned fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractions once they share a denominator, including subtracting fractional parts within mixed-number problems.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a common denominator
Tag when fractional parts of mixed numbers are subtracted after denominators are already the same or have been made the same
Tag when the fraction result is zero or negative before any regrouping
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag finding the common denominator itself
Do not tag subtraction of whole-number parts alone
Do not tag simplification of the resulting fraction unless subtraction is also performed in that step

skills.name: Subtract whole parts
skills.definition: Subtract the whole-number components in a mixed-number or whole-number subtraction setup.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly subtracts whole parts such as 4 − 3 = 1
Tag when whole-part subtraction appears alongside fraction-part subtraction in the same step
Tag when the whole-part result is later adjusted by borrowing
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag pure fraction items with no whole-number component
Do not tag borrowing itself unless the step also performs the whole-part subtraction
Do not tag final combination steps that merely state the mixed-number answer

skills.name: Borrow across parts
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units to continue subtraction when the fractional part of the minuend is too small.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step borrows 1 from the whole-number part
Tag when a borrowed whole is converted into denominator-over-denominator and added to the existing fraction
Tag when regrouping resolves a negative fractional difference in a mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction problem
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag straightforward subtraction when no regrouping is needed
Do not tag normalization of improper mixed numbers before subtraction
Do not tag simplification after regrouping unless the borrowing action is present

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce the subtraction result to lowest terms or to an integer when the fractional part equals zero or the fraction can be simplified.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced, such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 9/12 to 3/4
Tag when 0 over a denominator is simplified to 0
Tag when a mixed-number result is simplified because its fractional part is zero
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction steps that already produce a lowest-terms fraction with no explicit simplification
Do not tag combining whole and fraction parts unless simplification is explicitly performed
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number before subtraction

skills.name: Combine final form
skills.definition: Assemble the computed whole and fractional parts into the final mixed number, fraction, or integer answer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step combines a whole-part result and a fraction-part result into one mixed number
Tag when a step states that a zero whole part leaves only the fraction
Tag when a step combines whole and zero fraction to produce an integer
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag earlier subtraction or borrowing steps
Do not tag simplification alone unless the step also explicitly combines parts into the final form
Do not tag pure fraction subtraction steps that already present the final fraction without any combining of parts
